map.输入工资标准、出勤时长与加班类型，按《劳动法》第44条分别以 1.5 倍、2 倍: Enter the wage standard, attendance hours and overtime type, and compute the total overtime pay for weekdays, rest days and statutory holidays at 1.5, 2 and 3 times the wage respectively, per Article 44 of the Labor Law.
map.填写「每日工作小时数」。: Enter the hours worked per day.
map.填写「法定节假日加班小时」。: Enter the statutory holiday overtime hours.

map.核算工作日延长、休息日、法定节假日三类加班费，核对是否足额支付。: Account for the three kinds of overtime pay (weekday extension, rest days, statutory holidays) and check whether they are paid in full.
map.休息日加班不能补休的支付 200%，法定节假日支付 300%。: Overtime on rest days that cannot be compensated with leave is paid at 200%, and statutory holidays at 300%.
map.HR 用于薪酬合规自查，劳动者用于维权举证。: HR uses it for compensation compliance self-checks, and employees use it as evidence when defending their rights.
Daily wage = 10000 / 21.75 = about 459.77 CNY, hourly about 57.47 CNY. Weekday overtime of 10 hours is about 862 CNY; one rest-day overtime day (200%) about 920 CNY; one statutory holiday (300%) about 1379 CNY; total about 3161 CNY.
map.：休息日加班 2 天且未补休：459.77 × 2 × 2 = 1839 元。: Two rest-day overtime days with no compensatory leave: 459.77 x 2 x 2 = 1839 CNY.
map.法定月计薪天数 =（365 − 104 休息日）÷ 12 = 21.75 天，用: The statutory monthly paid days = (365 - 104 rest days) / 12 = 21.75 days, used to convert to daily and hourly wages.
map.法定节假日加班能用补休代替吗？: Can statutory holiday overtime be replaced with compensatory leave?
map.不能，法定节假日安排工作的应支付不低于工资 300% 的报酬，不得以补休替代；休: No. Work arranged on statutory holidays must be paid at no less than 300% of the wage and cannot be replaced with compensatory leave; overtime on rest days may prioritize compensatory leave.
